tool_args.rationale: The five initial observations cover only short horizons and are consistent with positive short-window gain; they cannot distinguish the dual-horizon reversal at the target horizon. Acquire the targeted slow-horizon probe before fitting.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the dual-horizon sink-coupled adaptation model from the five initial rows
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: All five rows have H≤0.48, so they do not identify long-horizon behavior needed at H=20.4.
More short-horizon measurements would not resolve the key long-horizon identifiability gap.
It is irrelevant to the candidate law and would add cost without resolving uncertainty.
